notes.title: WalkinVR Update 2.2.0.0 - New feature: Remote VR Control
notes.notes:
Hello 🙂

Remote VR Control lets you take control of a VR headset from a computer, allowing you to rotate, move in space, and use controllers to interact with the environment. If you're playing with someone and need to select an option from a menu or interact on their behalf, you can now do it from a PC—without removing their headset or taking the controllers away.

This feature is designed for Professional users who assist players in various games and need a quick, seamless way to help without disrupting the player's experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37600958/95e158e2e31019c4ab909f2b17940590a3500431.png[/img]

I hope many find this feature useful!
Let me know what you think 🙂
Greg

notes.title: WalkinVR 2.1 Update - Hand Tracking
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=xY6f9a_w9AU;full][/previewyoutube]

How to use VR Controllers when you can’t hold them in hands? This question kept us at work for a long time, but the solution is finally here :) The hand tracking feature for WalkinVR will allow everyone to use VR without using controllers.

We have just finished testing it with our friends - players with disabilities - and the results were astonishing. Kinect makes tracking easy and efficient, they’ve had a great run with Beat Saber, AudioShield, Job Simulator and plenty of other games.

notes.title: WalkinVR Release on Steam
notes.notes:
WalkinVR Driver is a software program for people with physical disabilities which aims to make Virtual Reality Games and Applications more accessible.
First release includes following functionalities:
- Virtual Movement
- Adjustment of Controller Position
- Gameplay with Personal Assistant

Hand tracking will be released within 2-3 weeks from now as an update.
